```{r}
source("common_functions.R")
```

# read in metadata

```{r}
# load in metadata
metadata_full <- readxl::read_xlsx("metadata_U.xlsx", sheet = 1, na = c("", " ", "NA"))
metadata_full <- metadata_full %>% filter(!is.na(sample_ID))

# create final taxa variables in metadata - when a nuclear DNA confirmed species identification exists, use it, otherwise use the previously determined species identification
metadata_taxa <- metadata_full %>% mutate(final_genus = case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ genus,
                                                    .default = nuclear_genus),
                                final_species = case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ species,
                                                      .default = nuclear_species),
                                final_phylum = case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ phylum,
                                                      .default = nuclear_phylum),
                                final_class= case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ class,
                                                      .default = nuclear_class),
                                final_order= case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ order,
                                                      .default = nuclear_order),
                                final_family= case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ family,
                                                      .default = nuclear_family),
                                final_subspecies= case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ subspecies,
                                                      .default = nuclear_subspecies),
                                final_tribe= case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ tribe,
                                                      .default = nuclear_tribe),
                                final_division= case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ division,
                                                      .default = nuclear_division),
                                .keep = "unused")
# remove whitespace
metadata_taxa <- metadata_taxa %>% mutate(f_genus = str_replace_all(final_genus, " ", ""),
                                f_species = str_replace_all(final_species, " ", ""),
                                f_subspecies = str_replace_all(final_subspecies, " ", ""),
                                number = str_replace_all(voucher_or_tissue_number, " ", ""),
                                .keep = "unused")

# create Lineage) variable
metadata_taxa <- metadata_taxa %>% 
  mutate(lineage = case_when(!is.na(f_subspecies) ~ paste(f_genus, f_species, f_subspecies, sep = "_"),
                         .default = paste(f_genus, f_species, sep = "_")))

# add tree labels to metadata_taxa
metadata_taxa <- metadata_taxa %>% 
  mutate(lineage_plus_specimen_ID = paste(metadata_taxa$lineage, metadata_taxa$number, sep = "_"))

# create full_species_name variable
metadata_taxa <- metadata_taxa %>% 
  mutate(full_species_name = paste(f_genus, f_species, sep = "_"))

# rename clade variable
metadata_taxa <- metadata_taxa %>% 
  rename(clade = "defined_clade_for_reciprocal_monophyly_criteria")

# store sampleID to clade lookup for getting unique haplotypes for clades
write_csv(metadata_taxa %>% select(sample_ID, clade), "sample_to_clade_lookup.csv")

# store sampleID to clade lookup for hydromyini only for getting unique haplotypes for clades
write_csv(metadata_taxa %>% filter(final_tribe == "Hydromyini") %>% select(sample_ID, clade), "hydromyini_sample_to_clade_lookup.csv")

# create lookup table for new names
lookup_new <- tibble(sample_ID = metadata_taxa$sample_ID, lineage_plus_specimen_ID = paste(metadata_taxa$lineage, metadata_taxa$number, sep = "_"))

# Add lookup for reference - only relevant for mito trees not trimmed to Hydromyini and outgroup only
reference_label <- tibble(sample_ID = "mus_musculus_reference_NC_005089.1", lineage_plus_specimen_ID = "mus_musculus_reference_NC_005089.1")

lookup_new <- rbind(reference_label, lookup_new)
```

# calculate average bootstrap score across taxonomy controlled 200bp window trees

```{r}
# calculate average bootstrap across taxonomy controlled, 200bp window trees
taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap <- average_bootstrap(IQTREE_metadata_taxa_control$updated_tips, "", "", "")

# rename loci variable to treefile
taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$full_bootstrap_values <- 
  taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$full_bootstrap_values %>% 
  rename(updated_tips = "loci")

# join metadata
taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$full_bootstrap_values <- 
  left_join(taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$full_bootstrap_values,
            IQTREE_metadata_taxa_control, by = c("updated_tips")) %>% 
  rename(loci = "updated_tips")

taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$full_bootstrap_values <- taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$full_bootstrap_values %>% 
  mutate(loci = basename(loci)) %>% # get base file name
  mutate(loci = str_split_fixed(loci, "_", n = 2)[,1]) # get loci prefix

# recalculate average bootstrap score per loci and overwrite average_bootstrap_table
taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$average_bootstrap_table <- taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$full_bootstrap_values %>% 
  group_by(loci) %>% 
  summarise(average_bootstrap_score = mean(bootstrap),
            variance = var(bootstrap),
            standard_deviation = sd(bootstrap),
            standard_error = sd(bootstrap)/sqrt(length(bootstrap))) %>% 
  ungroup()

# additionally calculate average bootstrap score by window
average_bootstrap_over_windows <- 
  taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$full_bootstrap_values %>% 
  group_by(loci, alignment_start_position,alignment_end_position,reference_start_position,reference_end_position) %>% 
  summarise(average_bootstrap_score = mean(bootstrap),
            variance = var(bootstrap),
            standard_deviation = sd(bootstrap),
            standard_error = sd(bootstrap)/sqrt(length(bootstrap))) %>% 
  ungroup()


# combine bootstrap tables
average_bootstrap_values <- taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$average_bootstrap_table
full_bootstrap_values <- taxa_length_controlled_bootstrap$full_bootstrap_values
```

# Determine windows for reciprocal monophyly analysis

```{r}
# access windows with minimum 80% bootstrap + broad distribution to compare bootstrap w/ RM

best_bootstrap <- average_bootstrap_over_windows %>% 
  filter(average_bootstrap_score >= 80)

broad_bootstrap <- average_bootstrap_over_windows %>% 
  mutate(rounded_average = round(average_bootstrap_score)) %>% 
  filter(rounded_average < 80) %>% 
  arrange(rounded_average) %>% 
  group_by(rounded_average) %>% 
  slice(1)

# get alignment start positions
alignment_starts <- c(best_bootstrap$alignment_start_position, broad_bootstrap$alignment_start_position)

# get alignment end positions
alignment_ends <- c(best_bootstrap$alignment_end_position, broad_bootstrap$alignment_end_position)

# access IQTREE_metadata for length control to retrieve alignment file paths
reciprocal_monophyly_windows_metadata <- IQTREE_metadata %>% 
  filter(alignment_start_position %in% alignment_starts) %>% 
  select(!c(updated_tips, treefile, minimum_coverage_file)) # drop variables generated by IQTREE

# get matching 100bp windows
for (n in 1:length(alignment_starts)) {
  
  window_start <- alignment_starts[n]
  window_end <- alignment_ends[n]
  
  # filter 100bp metadata for window between 200bp start and end positions
  matching_100bp_window <- window_metadata_100bp %>% 
    filter(alignment_start_position > window_start) %>% 
    filter(alignment_end_position < window_end)
  
  # add 100bp window metadata to reciprocal monophyly window metadata
  reciprocal_monophyly_windows_metadata <-
    rbind(reciprocal_monophyly_windows_metadata, matching_100bp_window)
  
}

write_csv(reciprocal_monophyly_windows_metadata, file = "reciprocal_monophyly_windows_metadata.csv")

reciprocal_monophyly_windows_metadata
```

# Determine reciprocal monophyly for selected 200bp and associated 100bp window trees

```{r}
# colour branches by clade for reciprocal monophyly determination

# create colour lookup

lookup_colour <- tibble(lineage_plus_specimen_ID = paste(metadata_taxa$lineage, metadata_taxa$number, sep = "_"), tribe = metadata_taxa$final_tribe, clade = metadata_taxa$clade)

# update bracket characters to hyphens as tip.label does not support brackets
lookup_colour$lineage_plus_specimen_ID <- str_replace_all(lookup_colour$lineage_plus_specimen_ID,"[(]","-")
lookup_colour$lineage_plus_specimen_ID <- str_replace_all(lookup_colour$lineage_plus_specimen_ID,"[)]","-")
lookup_colour$clade <- str_replace_all(lookup_colour$clade,"[(]","-")
lookup_colour$clade <- str_replace_all(lookup_colour$clade,"[)]","-")

# filter for only Hydromyini species
lookup_colour <- lookup_colour %>% 
  filter(tribe == "Hydromyini") %>%
  select(!tribe)

# convert not to be considered for RM to individual clade values - i.e each assembly in these clades will be considered individually rather than as a group
not_to_be_considered <- lookup_colour %>%
  filter(clade %in% c("Uromys_caudimaculatus", #excluded due to taxonomic uncertainty
                      "Pogonomelomys_mayeri", #excluded due to non-monophyly in a nuclear phylogeny (Roycroft et al., 2022)
                      "Melomys_burtoni", #excluded due to taxonomic uncertainty and non-monophyly in whole mitogenome phylogeny
                      "Melomys_lutillus")) %>% #excluded due to taxonomic uncertainty and non-monophyly in whole mitogenome phylogeny
  mutate(clade = paste(clade, row_number(), sep = "_"))

# rbind not to be considered clades and filter out original clade names
lookup_colour <- rbind(lookup_colour, not_to_be_considered)
lookup_colour <- lookup_colour %>% 
  filter(!(clade %in% c("Uromys_caudimaculatus",
                        "Pogonomelomys_mayeri",
                        "Melomys_burtoni",
                        "Melomys_lutillus")))

# get one row per label in tree - duplicates caused by multiple libraries derived from same individual in metadata
lookup_colour <- lookup_colour %>% 
  group_by(lineage_plus_specimen_ID) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

# ALTERNATE LOOKUP WITH NT AND WA DELICATULUS LISTED SEPARATELY
alternate_delicatulus <- metadata_taxa %>% 
  filter(clade == "Pseudomys_delicatulus") %>% 
  mutate(clade = case_when(state_or_region == "Northern Territory" ~ paste0(clade, "_NT"),
                           state_or_region == "Western Australia" ~ paste0(clade, "_WA"))) %>% 
  select(lineage_plus_specimen_ID, clade) %>% 
  group_by(lineage_plus_specimen_ID) %>% # drop multiple rows per tree label
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()  

lookup_colour <- rbind(lookup_colour, alternate_delicatulus)
```

```{r}
# root all trees on mus_musculus and update tip labels

# create empty vector to store filepath labels
new_filepath_list <- c()

for (n in 1:length(reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$treefile)) {

  original_tree <- read.tree(reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$treefile[n])
  
  # root on mus musculus
  
  root_reference <- original_tree$tip.label[grep("NC_005089", original_tree$tip.label)]
  
  rooted_tree <- RootTree(original_tree, root_reference)
  
  # get tree directory
  tree_directory <- dirname(reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$treefile[n])
  
  # get treefile_name
  treefile_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$treefile[n]))
  
  # create new filename for rerooted tree
  new_filepath <- paste0(tree_directory, "/", treefile_name, "_trimmed_rooted.treefile")
  
  write.tree(rooted_tree, new_filepath)

  # update tip labels
  rooted_tree_updated_tips_sample_ID <- rename_tips_sample_ID(rooted_tree, add_names_old = "NC_005089.1", add_names_new = "mus_musculus_reference_NC_005089.1")
  
  # add reference ID to tmp lookup table
  
  reference_label <- tibble(sample_ID = "mus_musculus_reference_NC_005089.1",
                            lineage_plus_specimen_ID = "mus_musculus_reference_NC_005089.1")

lookup_new_tmp <- rbind(reference_label, lookup_new)
  
  rooted_tree_updated_tips_lineage <- rename_tips(rooted_tree_updated_tips_sample_ID, lookup_new_tmp$sample_ID, lookup_new_tmp$lineage_plus_specimen_ID)
  
  # create new filename for updated tips tree
  new_filepath <- paste0(tree_directory, "/", treefile_name, "_trimmed_rooted_updated_tips.treefile")
  
  write.tree(rooted_tree_updated_tips_lineage, new_filepath)

  # store filepath to updated tree
  new_filepath_list <- c(new_filepath_list, new_filepath)
  
}

# add updated_tips trees to IQTREE metadata
reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$updated_tips <- new_filepath_list
```

#### Reciprocal Monophyly Classification

```{r}
# auto-calculate Reciprocal Monophyly

# create empty tibbles to store overall reciprocal monophyly determination
clade_stats <- NULL

# create empty object to store included ineligible tips
all_included_ineligible <- NULL

# create empty object to store all clade counts
clade_representatives <- NULL

# read in trees

for (tree_number in 1:nrow(reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata)) {
  
  # create null object for tree clade stats
  tree_clade_stats <- NULL

reciprocal_phylogeny_tree <- read.tree(reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$updated_tips[tree_number])

# get intersection of labels in tree and labels in colour lookup
common_labels <- intersect(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$tip.label, lookup_colour$lineage_plus_specimen_ID)

# filter colour lookup to tips in tree
lookup_colour_tmp <- lookup_colour %>% 
  filter(lineage_plus_specimen_ID %in% common_labels)

# get list of clades with at least 3 representatives (eligible for classification as monophyletic or reciprocally monophyletic)
clade_colour_list <- lookup_colour_tmp %>%
  group_by(clade) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  filter(count >= 3)

clade_colour_list <- clade_colour_list$clade

# get list of clades with 2x representatives
multi_represented_ineligible <- lookup_colour_tmp %>%
  group_by(clade) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  filter(count == 2)

multi_represented_ineligible <- multi_represented_ineligible$clade

# get list of clades with 1x representatives
single_represented_ineligible <- lookup_colour_tmp %>%
  group_by(clade) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  filter(count == 1)
single_represented_ineligible <- lookup_colour_tmp %>% filter(clade %in% single_represented_ineligible$clade)
single_represented_ineligible <- single_represented_ineligible$lineage_plus_specimen_ID

# create tibble for tip labels and include tip number in tree
tip_labels_list <- tibble(tip_labels = reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$tip.label)
tip_labels_list <- tip_labels_list %>% 
  mutate(tip_number = row_number())

# create NULL remove object for storing tips to remove
remove <- NULL

# loop over clades with 2x representatives to determine if they will be retained as comparisons in the reciprocal monophyly classification; retained if they are sisters in the tree
for (clade in 1:length(multi_represented_ineligible)) {
  
  current_clade <- multi_represented_ineligible[clade]
  
  # get tip labels for clade
  current_tips <- lookup_colour_tmp %>% filter(clade == current_clade)
  current_tips <- current_tips$lineage_plus_specimen_ID
  
  # get MRCA for tips
  MRCA_of_ineligible <- getMRCA(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, current_tips)
  
  # get tip number of ineligible tips
  ineligible_tip_numbers <- tip_labels_list %>% 
    filter(tip_labels %in% current_tips)
  ineligible_tip_numbers <- ineligible_tip_numbers$tip_number
  
  # get descendants of MRCA
  ineligible_descendants <- getDescendants(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, MRCA_of_ineligible)
  
  # filter tip label numbers for ineligible descendants to exclude internal nodes
  ineligible_descendants <- tip_labels_list %>% 
    filter(tip_number %in% ineligible_descendants)
  ineligible_descendants <- ineligible_descendants$tip_number
  
  # check that length of ineligible tip numbers and ineligible descendants are equal - if not, tips are not sister and should be excluded
  if (length(ineligible_descendants) != length(ineligible_tip_numbers)) {
    # more descendants than expected, add tip labels to remove list
    remove <- c(remove, current_tips)
  }
}

# loop over clades with 1x representative to determine if they will be retained as comparisons in the reciprocal monophyly classification; retained if >=80 bootstrap support
for (tip in 1:length(single_represented_ineligible)) {
  no_clade_tip_label <- single_represented_ineligible[tip]
  sister_node <- getSisters(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, no_clade_tip_label)
  shared_node <- getParent(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, sister_node)
  # subtract tip labels from node number to get corresponding node label number
  node_label_number <- shared_node - length(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$tip.label)
  bootstrap_value_of_node <- reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$node.label[node_label_number]
  # extract bootstrap from SH-aLRT - if blank assume identical
  if (bootstrap_value_of_node == "") {
    bootstrap_value_of_node <- 100
  } else {
    bootstrap_value_of_node <- str_split_i(bootstrap_value_of_node, pattern = "/", i = 2)
    bootstrap_value_of_node <- as.numeric(bootstrap_value_of_node)
  }
  # if bootstrap below threshold of 80, add to remove tip list
  if (bootstrap_value_of_node < 80) {
    remove <- c(remove, no_clade_tip_label)
  }
}

# remove clades with 1x and 2x representatives that fail bootstrap support/sister tests
reciprocal_phylogeny_tree <- drop.tip(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$tip.label[match(remove, reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$tip.label)])

# redefine colour lookup to new included tips and save as new tmp lookup
common_labels <- intersect(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$tip.label,
                           lookup_colour_tmp$lineage_plus_specimen_ID)

lookup_colour_all_tmp <- lookup_colour_tmp %>% 
  filter(lineage_plus_specimen_ID %in% common_labels)

# redefine colour lookup to only contain reciprocally monophyletic eligible sequences
lookup_colour_tmp <- lookup_colour_tmp %>% 
  filter(clade %in% clade_colour_list)

# save separate list of included RM ineligible sequences
included_ineligible <- lookup_colour_all_tmp %>% 
  filter(!(clade %in% clade_colour_list))

## Remove partially complete assemblies if not required to make up minimum 3x individuals - will exclude sequences 80-95% complete across windows if clade has sufficient >95% complete representatives, all <80% assemblies removed prior to phylogeny generation

# get treefile_name
treefile_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$treefile[tree_number]))

# read in coverage.csv
sequence_coverage <- read_csv(paste0("rodent_loci_windows/reciprocal_monophyly_windows/sequence_coverage_data/", treefile_name, "_count_bp.csv"))

# drop NAs for coverage
sequence_coverage <- sequence_coverage %>% 
  filter(!is.na(num_bp))

# join metadata to sequence coverage by sample_ID to get names in tree
sequence_coverage <- left_join(sequence_coverage,
                               metadata_taxa %>% select(sample_ID, lineage_plus_specimen_ID),
                               by = "sample_ID")
# update bracket characters to hyphens in lineages as tip.label does not support brackets
sequence_coverage$lineage_plus_specimen_ID <-
  str_replace_all(sequence_coverage$lineage_plus_specimen_ID,"[(]","-")
sequence_coverage$lineage_plus_specimen_ID <-
  str_replace_all(sequence_coverage$lineage_plus_specimen_ID,"[)]","-")

# join sequence coverage to eligible lookup table by name in tree
sequence_coverage <- left_join(lookup_colour_tmp, sequence_coverage, by = "lineage_plus_specimen_ID")

# filter for minimum 95% coverage then count representatives per clade
high_sequence_coverage_samples <- sequence_coverage %>% 
  filter(coverage >= .95)
high_sequence_coverage_clades <- high_sequence_coverage_samples %>% 
  group_by(clade) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  filter(count >= 3)
high_sequence_coverage_clades <- high_sequence_coverage_clades$clade

# filter high coverage samples for only those with minimum three high coverage clade reps
high_sequence_coverage_samples <- high_sequence_coverage_samples %>% 
  filter(clade %in% high_sequence_coverage_clades) %>% 
  select(lineage_plus_specimen_ID, clade)

# filter sequence coverage for clades NOT represented by minimum 3 high coverage reps
low_sequence_coverage_samples <- sequence_coverage %>% 
  filter(!(clade %in% high_sequence_coverage_clades))

# create new tree label for included low coverage, note low sequence coverage samples does include high coverage samples for clades with less than 3 high coverage representatives
actually_low_sequence_coverage_samples <- low_sequence_coverage_samples %>% 
  filter(coverage < .95) %>% 
  mutate(new_label = paste(lineage_plus_specimen_ID, "LOW_COVERAGE", coverage, sep = "_"))

# get samples to remove from lookup and tree by subsetting lookup to tree labels NOT in low or high coverage lists
remove <- lookup_colour_tmp %>% 
  filter(!(lineage_plus_specimen_ID %in% c(high_sequence_coverage_samples$lineage_plus_specimen_ID,
                                       low_sequence_coverage_samples$lineage_plus_specimen_ID)))
remove <- remove$lineage_plus_specimen_ID

# redefine both lookups to exclude remove samples
lookup_colour_tmp <- lookup_colour_tmp %>% 
  filter(!(lineage_plus_specimen_ID %in% remove))
lookup_colour_all_tmp <- lookup_colour_all_tmp %>% 
  filter(!(lineage_plus_specimen_ID %in% remove))

# drop excluded low coverage samples from tree
reciprocal_phylogeny_tree <- drop.tip(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$tip.label[match(remove, reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$tip.label)])

# if actually low coverage has rows redefine lookups to have new low coverage tree labels
if (nrow(actually_low_sequence_coverage_samples) > 0) {
  lookup_colour_tmp <- left_join(lookup_colour_tmp, actually_low_sequence_coverage_samples) %>% 
    mutate(lineage_plus_specimen_ID = case_when(!is.na(new_label) ~ new_label,
                                            .default = lineage_plus_specimen_ID),
           .keep = "unused",
           .before = 0)
  
  lookup_colour_all_tmp <- left_join(lookup_colour_all_tmp,
                                     actually_low_sequence_coverage_samples) %>%
    mutate(old_label = lineage_plus_specimen_ID) %>% 
    mutate(lineage_plus_specimen_ID = case_when(!is.na(new_label) ~ new_label,
                                            .default = lineage_plus_specimen_ID),
           .keep = "unused",
           .before = 0)
  
  # rename labels in tree
  reciprocal_phylogeny_tree <- rename_tips(reciprocal_phylogeny_tree,
                                           lookup_colour_all_tmp$old_label,
                                           lookup_colour_all_tmp$lineage_plus_specimen_ID)
  
  # drop old labels column for all lookup
  lookup_colour_all_tmp <- lookup_colour_all_tmp %>% 
    select(!old_label)
  
  # Print if low
  print(treefile_name)
  print(actually_low_sequence_coverage_samples)
    
}

## FINISH: FILTER OUT INCOMPLETE SEQUENCES WHEN NOT NEEDED TO MAKE UP MINIMUM 3 INDIVIDUALS

# colour tree
list_clades <- lookup_colour_tmp %>% group_by(clade) %>% summarise()
list_clades <- list_clades$clade

# create new tree object for labeling with clade IDs
labelled_reciprocal_phylogeny_tree <- reciprocal_phylogeny_tree
  
  # convert tip labels in tree to tibble
  tree_tip_labels <- tibble(tips = labelled_reciprocal_phylogeny_tree$tip.label)
  # add row_numbers for tip labels
  tree_tip_labels <- tree_tip_labels %>% 
    mutate(tip_number = row_number())

# paint edges eligible for reciprocal monophyly proportion
for (c in 1:length(list_clades)) {
  current_clade <- list_clades[c]
  
  # get tip labels in current clade
  tiplabels_to_colour <- lookup_colour_tmp %>% filter(clade == current_clade)
  tiplabels_to_colour <- tiplabels_to_colour$lineage_plus_specimen_ID
  
  # get common ancestor of clade for auto determination of reciprocal monophyly
  clade_node_label <- findMRCA(labelled_reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, tiplabels_to_colour)
  
  # check if monophyletic
  
  # get descendants of clade MRCA
  descendant_nodes <- getDescendants(labelled_reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, clade_node_label)
  
  # remove expected clade tips from tip labels in tree then subset to descendent nodes matching tip labels
  tmp_tree_tip_labels <- tree_tip_labels %>% 
    filter(!(tips %in% tiplabels_to_colour)) %>% 
    filter(tip_number %in% descendant_nodes)
  
  # if tmp_tree_tip_labels has rows then monophyly is no
  if (nrow(tmp_tree_tip_labels) == 0) {
    is_clade_monophyletic <- "yes"
    is_clade_reciprocally_monophyletic <- "yes" # temp set, will overwrite if not true
  } else {
    is_clade_monophyletic <- "no"
    is_clade_reciprocally_monophyletic <- "no"
  }
  
  # if clade is monophyletic, check if sister clade includes all descendants of included clades
  if (is_clade_monophyletic == "yes") {
    
    # get sister node
    sister_clade_node <- getSisters(labelled_reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, clade_node_label)
    
    # if sister clade node is equal to or less than number of tips, equals single tip (tip labels numbered 1 to n)
    if (sister_clade_node <= nrow(tree_tip_labels)) {
      # set sister_desc_nodes equal to sister clade node
      sister_desc_nodes <- sister_clade_node
    } else {
      
      # get sister node descendants
      sister_desc_nodes <- getDescendants(labelled_reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, sister_clade_node)
      
    }
    
    # get tip labels of descendants
    tmp_tree_tip_labels <- tree_tip_labels %>% 
      filter(tip_number %in% sister_desc_nodes)
    
    # get clades of descendants
    descendant_nuclear_clades <- lookup_colour_all_tmp %>%
      filter(lineage_plus_specimen_ID %in% tmp_tree_tip_labels$tips)
    
    # if current clade = P. delicatulus, drop sub clades from consideration
    if (current_clade == "Pseudomys_delicatulus") {
      descendant_nuclear_clades <- descendant_nuclear_clades %>% 
        filter(!(clade %in% c("Pseudomys_delicatulus_NT", "Pseudomys_delicatulus_WA")))
    } else {
      # if current clade = anything else, drop overall clade from consideration - if overall clade is sister, will still be reciprocal even if geographic delicatulus not in reciprocal clades
      descendant_nuclear_clades <- descendant_nuclear_clades %>% 
        filter(!(clade == "Pseudomys_delicatulus"))
    }
    
    # get clades as list
    descendant_nuclear_clades <- unique(descendant_nuclear_clades$clade)
    
    # get MRCA of all descendant of clades
    for (clade in 1:length(descendant_nuclear_clades)) {
      
      # get current clade
      current_clade_for_RM <- descendant_nuclear_clades[clade]
      
      # get all tips for current clade
      all_tips_for_RM_check <- lookup_colour_all_tmp %>% filter(clade == current_clade_for_RM)
      
      # get MRCA of all tips
      MRCA_of_nuclear_clade <- findMRCA(labelled_reciprocal_phylogeny_tree, all_tips_for_RM_check$lineage_plus_specimen_ID)
      
      # if MRCA is NULL, then sister is single representative of clade, consider as RM
      # if MRCA is NOT NULL, then check that sister clade includes all nuclear clade descendants
      if (!is.null(MRCA_of_nuclear_clade)) {
        
        # create tmp list of sister node clade and descendant nodes
        sister_all_nodes <- c(sister_clade_node, sister_desc_nodes)
        
        # check if MRCA is equal to sister clade or included in sister clade nodes
        if (MRCA_of_nuclear_clade %in% sister_all_nodes) {
          # do not set RM
        } else {
          # set Reciprocal monophyly to no
          is_clade_reciprocally_monophyletic <- "no"
        }
        
      }
      
    }
    
  }
  
  # write clade monophyly information
    tmp_clade_stats <- tibble(length = reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$window_length[tree_number], start_position = reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$alignment_start_position[tree_number], end_position = reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$alignment_end_position[tree_number], clade = current_clade, reciprocal_monophyly = is_clade_reciprocally_monophyletic, monophyly = is_clade_monophyletic, clade_node = clade_node_label)
    
    # append to overall
    clade_stats <- rbind(clade_stats, tmp_clade_stats)
    
    # append to tree only clade stats
    tree_clade_stats <- rbind(tree_clade_stats, tmp_clade_stats)
    
}
  
  
# write included ineligible tips information
tmp_included_ineligible <- included_ineligible %>% 
  mutate(length = reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$window_length[tree_number],
         start_position = reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$alignment_start_position[tree_number],
         end_position = reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$alignment_end_position[tree_number])

# add to overall tibble
all_included_ineligible <- rbind(all_included_ineligible, tmp_included_ineligible)

# write ALL included tips information
tmp_clade_representatives <- lookup_colour_all_tmp %>% 
  select(lineage_plus_specimen_ID, clade) %>% 
  mutate(length = reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$window_length[tree_number],
         start_position = reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$alignment_start_position[tree_number],
         end_position = reciprocal_phylogeny_trees_metadata$alignment_end_position[tree_number])

# add to overall tibble
clade_representatives <- rbind(clade_representatives, tmp_clade_representatives)

## mutate tree clade stats for joint reciprocal monophyly_monophyly state
tree_clade_stats <- tree_clade_stats %>%
  mutate(RM_M = paste(reciprocal_monophyly, monophyly, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(RM_M = case_when(RM_M == "no_no" ~ "neither",
                          RM_M == "yes_yes" ~ "reciprocal",
                          RM_M == "no_yes" ~ "monophyletic")) %>% 
  arrange(clade_node) # arrange tree clade stats by clade node

# close loop through trees    
}

# save clade_representative as .csv
write_csv(clade_representatives, "window_clade_representatives.csv")

# create consensus delicatulus - if both subclades are RM OR whole clade is RM, then consensus is RM
delicatulus_consensus <- clade_stats %>% 
  filter(clade %in% c("Pseudomys_delicatulus", "Pseudomys_delicatulus_NT", "Pseudomys_delicatulus_WA")) %>% 
  select(!c(clade_node, monophyly)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = clade, values_from = reciprocal_monophyly) %>% 
  mutate(Pseudomys_delicatulus_consensus = case_when(Pseudomys_delicatulus == "yes" ~ "yes",
                                                     Pseudomys_delicatulus == "no" &
                                                       Pseudomys_delicatulus_NT == "yes" &
                                                       Pseudomys_delicatulus_WA == "yes" ~ "yes",
                                                     .default = "no")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(length, start_position, end_position), values_to = "reciprocal_monophyly", names_to = "clade") %>% 
  filter(clade == "Pseudomys_delicatulus_consensus")
# consensus will inherit monophyly and clade node from overall clade - EXCEPT WHEN RM, THEN COUNTED AS MONOPHYLETIC FOR PLOT PURPOSES
delicatulus_consensus <- left_join(delicatulus_consensus, clade_stats %>% filter(clade == "Pseudomys_delicatulus") %>% select(!c(clade, reciprocal_monophyly)), join_by(length, start_position, end_position))
delicatulus_consensus <- delicatulus_consensus %>% 
  mutate(monophyly = case_when(reciprocal_monophyly == "yes" ~ "yes",
                               .default = monophyly))
# join consensus to clade stats
clade_stats <- rbind(clade_stats, delicatulus_consensus)

# make clade_stats rows distinct to prevent rerun error that inflates consensus delicatulus
clade_stats <- clade_stats %>% distinct()



# calculate proportion - CALCULATE ONLY CONSENSUS DELICATULUS, NOT OTHERS
overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2 <- clade_stats %>% 
  filter(!(clade %in% c("Pseudomys_delicatulus", "Pseudomys_delicatulus_NT", "Pseudomys_delicatulus_WA"))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(reciprocal_monophyly, monophyly), values_to = "yes_no", names_to = "monophyly_type") %>% 
  group_by(length, start_position, end_position, monophyly_type, yes_no) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())

# get total number of considered clades
total_clades <- overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2 %>% 
  group_by(length, start_position, end_position, monophyly_type) %>% 
  summarise(total_clades = sum(count))

# join total_clades
overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2 <-
  left_join(overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2,
            total_clades, by = c("length", "start_position", "end_position", "monophyly_type"))

# calculate proportion
overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2 <- overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2 %>% 
  mutate(proportion = count / total_clades)

# convert length and position to character
overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2$length <- as.character(overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2$length)
overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2$start_position <- as.character(overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2$start_position)
overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2$end_position <- as.character(overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2$end_position)
```

# Reciprocal Monophyly Classification - Results

```{r}
# reciprocal monophyly results for each clade in each tested window
clade_stats


# summarised reciprocal monophyly results for each window - reports number of clades (count) that are/are not (yes_no) monophyletic or reciprocally monophyletic. Proportion is count of corresponding monophyly criteria (e.g. not monophyletic) / total clades that were considered for reciprocal monophyly criterion in the given window
overall_reciprocal_monophyly_proportion_2
```
